description: A real pangolin with articulated cobalt-and-ivory porcelain scales, brass hinges, and a temple-bell tail.
A carnivorous sundew with luminous amber nectar beads, delicate fan leaves, fine root feet, and faerie blossoms.
A real tapir with a short trunk, living cloud curls, teal wind ribbons, and copper spiral markings.
A non-animal floating spiral mantle with asymmetrical eyes, orbiting gold feather-shaped lights, and a pearl-and-indigo body.
A walking ring of watchful eyes and branching mycelial tendrils, modified by predatory moss and tiny violet spore cups.
An impossible folded ribbon creature with recursive limbs and aperture eyes, softened by translucent turquoise gel and droplet edges.
A real sugar glider with a cream-and-chestnut body, faerie membrane patterns, tiny lantern-like nectar lights, and long silk ear tufts.
An extinct thylacine with charcoal stripes, bone-white markings, spectral lavender breath, and a translucent tail.
An extinct giant ground sloth with massive curved claws, sandy shaggy fur, slate-gray calluses, and increasingly colossal proportions.
A luminous many-winged celestial guardian with ivory feathers, articulated golden wing frames, rotating crystal joints, and warm cyan light.
A six-winged celestial guardian whose feather fans become layered white lotus petals and living green tendrils around a radiant core.
An otherworldly halo-bearing celestial whose pearl armor reveals elegant ancestral bone and trails of pale blue soul light.
A wing-ring celestial composed of soft aurora ribbons, opaline feathers, and a brilliant coral-and-gold elemental heart.
A bronze automaton shaped with long heron-like legs and a curved mechanical beak, with emerald patina and articulated wing plates.
A walking black-and-vermilion lacquer vessel whose ceramic limbs are joined by clear amber jelly and floating brass fasteners.
A carved wooden marionette with a lacquered nonhuman mask, jointed branch limbs, faerie silk cords, and small luminous bell flowers.
A compact iron furnace automaton with swept infernal horns, coal-red vents, heavy linked gauntlets, and a glowing orange interior.
A living swirl of river water with curling current limbs, carnivorous reed fronds, floating seed pods, and jade ripples.
A living ash-and-ember whirlwind modified by spectral ribs and fading ancestral cloth, in charcoal, peach ember, and cold violet.
A spinning elemental sand creature with segmented glass rings and bronze pivot joints, using amber sand and teal glass highlights.
A creature of ringing blue plasma shaped into nested bell-like currents, altered by small feathered light arcs and a gold celestial crown.
A small nonhuman woodland faerie with velvet mothlike wings, dormouse whiskers, nimble paws, and a plum-and-cream tufted tail.
A faerie with curled fernlike ears and delicate insect wings whose mint-colored body flows into transparent gel skirts and dew beads.
A slender faerie with a moth-wing cloak, smooth porcelain insect mask, six-fingered hands, and a bipedal but visibly nonhuman body.
A mischievous faerie with curled leaf wings, a striped violet tail, little infernal antlers, and ember-red thorn tips.
A horned fiend with a barbed tail and folded membrane wings, overgrown by burgundy pitcher plants and hooked olive thorns.
A long-armed horned fiend with brass jaw plates, dark iron chain loops, riveted shoulder guards, and red-hot joint seams.
A charcoal-skinned winged fiend with curling ivory horns, a fractured luminous feather halo, and silver celestial markings; no moral alignment implied.
A crouching horned fiend whose glossy black body drips into viscous oil-like gel, with ochre eyes and amber-lit cracks.
A colossal D&D-like broad-shouldered giant, starting as a young giant, with sandstone skin, a moss beard, and bonsai-like thorn trees growing across its back.
A colossal D&D-like giant with a huge cloud beard, storm-gray skin, broad hands, and thunderhead hair lit with small blue arcs.
A colossal D&D-like humanoid giant with powerful limbs, dark red lacquer armor panels, stone shoulder bastions, and gold mechanical braces.
A colossal D&D-like giant with slate skin, ancient wrappings, exposed spectral rib markings, and a heavy stone burial mask.
A visibly nonhuman biped with a moth head, four delicate grasping forearms, soft fur cuffs, and broad patterned antennae; never a human.
A visibly nonhuman human-shaped spirit with a reed-bundle head, hollow wooden face, two long legs, and living strangler-vine fingers; never a human.
A visibly nonhuman four-armed biped with a shifting mirrored face, offset eyes, ribbon joints, and asymmetric turquoise glass skin; never a human.
A visibly nonhuman avian-headed biped with taloned hands, opaline feather crests, long ceremonial-looking plumage, and a small radiant wing mantle.
An amphiptere from myth: a feather-winged serpent without walking legs, modified by swirling storm currents and blue-white feather sparks.
A kelpie from Celtic myth: an eerie long-maned water horse modified by carnivorous aquatic vines, reed fins, and hooked green tendrils.
A fenghuang from Chinese myth with elaborate tail plumes, modified by bronze feather joints, jade inlays, and articulated golden crest plates.
A basilisk from myth with a crownlike crest and serpentine body, modified by translucent violet gel, floating scales, and dripping glassy edges.
An amorphous amber ooze containing floating bronze mechanisms and broken porcelain charms, with pseudopod feet and a fluid silhouette.
A translucent pearlescent ooze with floating feather-shaped lights, small golden ring arcs, and luminous blue pseudopods.
An amorphous green jelly creature containing living carnivorous pitcher cups and red sundew tendrils, with soft gel feet and trapped seed pods.
An ectoplasmic ooze with pale lavender gel, drifting small bones, skull-like bubbles, and wispy trailing pseudopods.
A dangerous strangler fig with mobile root legs, modified by bronze vine hinges, iron bark plates, and articulated trapping branches.
A carnivorous pitcher plant with deep red trapping cups, hornlike leaf tips, black roots, and sulfurous orange lure vapor.
A dangerous gympie-gympie stinging plant with dense needle hairs, modified by hedgehog-like leaf spines and quick root paws.
A jiangshi from Chinese undead folklore with an unmistakably nonliving stiff hopping body, altered by faerie moth wings, soft lantern light, and flowering talisman-like leaves.
A draugr from Norse undead folklore with weathered burial armor and a skeletal sea-worn face, altered by swirling salt wind and turquoise storm mist.
